entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that receives messages and performs error handling procedures.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: Network entity that receives messages and performs error handling procedures.

entities.name: Error Handling Procedure
entities.description: Procedure executed when UE or network receives a message with specific error conditions.

entities.name: EMM STATUS
entities.description: EMM status message sent to indicate error conditions in EMM procedures.

entities.name: ESM STATUS
entities.description: ESM status message sent to indicate error conditions in ESM procedures.

entities.name: Cause #96
entities.description: Cause value indicating 'invalid mandatory information' in status messages.

entities.name: Error Conditions
entities.description: Conditions that trigger error handling: imperative message part error, missing mandatory IE, syntactically incorrect mandatory IE, unknown comprehension required IE, or out of sequence comprehension required IE.

entities.name: Excluded Messages for UE
entities.description: Messages listed in clause 7.5.3, items a, b, c, or d that are excluded from UE error handling procedure.

entities.name: Excluded Messages for Network
entities.description: Messages listed in clause 7.5.3, items e, f, g, or h that are excluded from network error handling procedure.

relations.description: Error handling procedure is triggered by specific error conditions.
UE performs error handling procedure when error conditions are met.
Network performs error handling procedure when error conditions are met.
Error handling procedure results in sending EMM STATUS message with cause #96.
Error handling procedure results in sending ESM STATUS message with cause #96.
Status messages sent during error handling contain cause #96.
UE error handling procedure is not applied to excluded messages.
Network error handling procedure is not applied to excluded messages.
